# LibreOffice Writer GUI Interface

## Window and Application Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Left: "Activities" label
  - Center: "LibreOffice Writer" application name
  - Right: System time "Oct 22 23:31" and system tray icons (including sound and network indicators)

- **Document Title Bar**
  - Center: "15-MB-docx-file-download.docx - LibreOffice Writer"
  - Right: Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Options** (from left to right)
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## Toolbar

- **Quick Access Toolbar** (above main toolbar)
  - Icons for: New document, Open, Save, Save As, Print, Export as PDF, Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Spelling and Grammar, and more.

- **Main Formatting Toolbar**
  - **Styles Dropdown**: "Normal (Web)" with dropdown arrow
  - **Font Selection**: "Times New Roman" with dropdown arrow
  - **Font Size**: "12 pt" with dropdown arrow
  - **Text Formatting Buttons**: Bold (B), Italic (I), Underline (U), Strikethrough (S)
  - **Font Color and Highlight**: Font color dropdown, highlight color dropdown
  - **Text Alignment**: Left, Center, Right, Justify
  - **List and Indentation**: Bulleted list, Numbered list, Decrease indent, Increase indent
  - **Paragraph Formatting**: Line spacing, Indentation, Borders, and more

## Status Bar

- **Document Information**
  - Left: "Page 1 of 15"
  - Center: "4,082 words, 27,523 characters"
  - Middle: "Default Page Style"
  - Right: "English (India)"

- **Zoom Control**
  - Zoom slider with "100%" label
  - Zoom in/out buttons

## Sidebar (Right Panel)

- **Sidebar Icons** (from top to bottom)
  - **Formatting Paintbrush**: For applying formatting to selected text or objects
  - **Styles**: For managing and applying document styles
  - **Page Layout**: For adjusting page layout settings
  - **Document Properties**: For viewing and editing document properties
  - **Navigation Pane**: For navigating through the document

## Document Content

- **Document Body**
  - **Image**: A map titled "Boundary Waters Trip" with a legend indicating different days of a trip.
    - Legend includes: Day 1, Day 2, Day 3, Day 4, Day 5, Day 6, and Entry Point 24.
    - Map shows various routes and locations such as New York Island, Washington Island, and others.
    - Map credits: "Google Earth" with copyright information.
  - **Text Below Image**: Three paragraphs of placeholder Latin text (Lorem Ipsum style).

## Notification Bar

- **Blue Notification Bar** (above document content)
  - Left: Two informational icons with text
    - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
    - "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - Right: Two buttons
    - "Get involved"
    - "Donate"

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock (Application Launcher)**
  - Icons for: Google Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC Media Player, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, Software Center, Help, and Trash.

- **Bottom Dock (System Tray)**
  - System tray icons for: Sound, Network, and other system functions.

## Document View

- **Document View Area**
  - Document is displayed in a single-page view.
  - Document is centered on the page with margins.
  - Text is formatted in Times New Roman, 12 pt font.
  - The document contains an image and three paragraphs of text.

## Document Metadata

- **Document Properties**
  - Document is named "15-MB-docx-file-download.docx"
  - Document is 15 MB in size.
  - Document is in LibreOffice Writer format.
  - Document is 15 pages long.
  - Document contains 4,082 words and 27,523 characters.
  - Document is in English (India) language.
  - Document is in Default Page Style.

## Document Layout

- **Page Layout**
  - Document is in a single-page view.
  - Document is centered on the page with margins.
  - Document is formatted with a header and footer.
  - Document is formatted with a title and subtitle.
